game.intro:
Your character runs on its own.
Tap the screen: jump.
Hold: jump higher.
As you progress, the world's rules will change every 5 seconds!
hint.boost: Speed arrows give you a boost!
hint.mech.FAST: Everything is fast! Jump a little early.
hint.mech.GHOST: Purple platforms vanish after they blink!
hint.mech.ICE: On ice you speed up little by little.
hint.mech.REVERSE_CONTROL: You jump by yourself! Hold under the spikes.
hint.mech.REVERSE_GRAVITY: You can jump on the ceiling too: just tap!
hint.mech.SHIFTING: Platforms with arrows slide up and down.
hint.mech.SLOW: Time slowed down, no need to rush.
hint.mech.SMALL: You shrank! You can pass through narrow gaps.
hint.moving: Time your jump onto the moving platform!
hint.overhead: Don't jump while there are spikes above you!
hint.run: Your character runs on its own.
hint.spikes: Don't touch the spikes, jump over them!
hint.tap: Now tap the screen to jump!
howto.hearts.text: You have {n} hearts in each attempt, and every fall costs 1 heart. Green flags are checkpoints: if you fall, you continue from there.
howto.hearts.title: Hearts and Checkpoints
howto.lives.title: Lives
howto.power.text: Grab the power-ups in bubbles: shield, magnet, double jump, invincibility, extra heart, coin multiplier, star finder and checkpoint guard.
howto.power.title: Power-ups
howto.rule5.text: Every 5 seconds the world's rules change. Before each change, the next rule blinks at the top of the screen. A rule change will never defeat you unfairly.
howto.rule5.title: The 5-Second Rule
howto.stars.text: Every level has 3 stars. Finish the level for 1 star, collect at least 2 stars for 2 stars, and collect all three with at most 1 mistake for 3 stars. Spend coins in the shop.
howto.stars.title: Stars and Coins
howto.tap.text: Your character runs on its own and jumps when you tap the screen. Hold to jump higher. You can still jump for a split second right after running off an edge.
howto.tap.title: Tap and Jump
level.piece_here: A secret piece is hidden in this level!
lives.quit_warning: You've lost a heart in this attempt; if you leave now, the life you spent won't come back.
lives.rules: A failed attempt costs 1 life; if you beat the level or leave without losing a heart, you get it back. You get 1 life back every {min} minutes, even while the game is closed. The first {free} levels and Endless World don't cost lives.
lives.title: Lives

privacy.ads: ADS: The game shows Google AdMob ads. To show and measure ads and to prevent fraud, Google's ads library automatically collects the following data and shares it with Google: IP address (may be used to estimate approximate location), in-app interactions (app launches, taps, ad views), diagnostics (such as launch time and battery use) and device identifiers. How Google uses this data: policies.google.com/technologies/partner-sites
privacy.ads_child: In this version, ads are requested in child-appropriate mode: they are not personalized, the device's advertising ID is not used, and only ads suitable for a general audience are shown.
privacy.ads_general: Depending on your consent, ads may be personalized to your interests and your device's advertising ID may be used. You can reset or delete the advertising ID in your device's Settings > Privacy > Ads. In countries where consent is required, you can change your choice with the Ad Preferences button on the Settings screen.
privacy.changes: CHANGES: If this policy changes, the updated text will be published on this screen and at the link on the store page.
privacy.children: CHILDREN: The game does not knowingly ask children for personal information.
privacy.contact: CONTACT: {dev}, via the developer email address shown on the Google Play page.
privacy.intro: {app} is a game developed by {dev} that can also be played offline. The game itself does not ask you for any personal information, and you don't need to create an account.
privacy.permissions: PERMISSIONS: Vibration (can be turned off in Settings); for the ads library: internet access, network state, ad measurement and background work.
privacy.purchases: PURCHASES: There are no real-money purchases. Coins, gems and lives are earned by playing or by optionally watching ads.
privacy.rewarded: REWARDED ADS are optional: they are shown only when you press a button that says "Watch ad".
privacy.save: SAVE FILE: Your progress (unlocked levels, stars, lives, language and other settings) is stored only on your device. If Android backup is turned on, this file may be included in your own Google account backup; the developer cannot access that backup. You can delete your save with the Reset Progress button on the Settings screen or by uninstalling the app.
